# IndianTimers (indiantimers.com)

> The definitive, officially audited examination countdown, schedule tracking, and student focus platform for India. Serves over 50+ national entrance, civil service, and board examinations with zero speculative dates.

IndianTimers provides precision live countdowns, official schedule milestones, distraction-free study timers (Pomodoro, Mock Test pacing with custom durations, Stopwatch), Google Calendar/ICS exports, personal student cockpits, embeddable HTML iframe widgets, and audited syllabus timelines.

## Core Examination Categories & Countdowns
- [Medical Entrance Exams (NEET UG, NEET PG, INI-CET)](https://indiantimers.com/exams/medical/): Live timers for NTA NEET UG 2027, AIIMS INI-CET, and NEET PG.
- [Engineering Entrance Exams (JEE Main, JEE Advanced, BITSAT, GATE)](https://indiantimers.com/exams/engineering/): Official schedules for JEE Main Session 1 & 2, IIT JEE Advanced, GATE 2027, VITEEE, and KCET.
- [Government & Civil Services (UPSC CSE, SSC CGL, State PSCs)](https://indiantimers.com/exams/government/): Audited UPSC Civil Services Prelims & Mains, SSC CGL, IBPS PO, and State PCS (UPPSC, BPSC, MPSC, KPSC).
- [Board Examinations (CBSE, ICSE, State Boards)](https://indiantimers.com/exams/board-exams/): CBSE Class 10 & 12 Board Exam 2027 schedules, ICSE/ISC, UP Board, and Maharashtra State Board.
- [Law Entrance Exams (CLAT, AILET, SLAT)](https://indiantimers.com/exams/law/): Common Law Admission Test (CLAT 2027 UG & PG) and National Law University AILET.
- [Management Entrance (CAT, XAT, SNAP)](https://indiantimers.com/exams/management/): IIM Common Admission Test (CAT 2026/2027), XLRI XAT, and SNAP.
- [Design, Architecture & Research](https://indiantimers.com/exams/other-entrance-exams/): NID DAT, NIFT, UCEED, NATA, and CSIR NET.

## Student Focus & Productivity Suite
- [My Exam Cockpit (Personal Workspace)](https://indiantimers.com/my-exams/): Private, local-first exam dashboard to pin target exams, add custom coaching mocks, track daily study hours, and export/import Schema V1 JSON backups without login.
- [Mock Test Simulation Timer](https://indiantimers.com/tools/mock-test-timer/): Real CBT exam pacing for NEET (200 min), JEE Main (180 min), UPSC Prelims (120 min), plus custom duration stepper (30m, 60m, 90m, custom) with live per-question time recalculation.
- [Embeddable Exam Countdown Widgets](https://indiantimers.com/tools/countdown/embed/): Free, responsive HTML iframe embed code generator for educational blogs, WordPress, Notion, and coaching LMS portals.
- [Shareable Live Countdowns](https://indiantimers.com/countdown/): Instant shareable countdown URLs with full-screen theater presentation and cockpit synchronization.
- [Pomodoro Focus Timer](https://indiantimers.com/tools/pomodoro-timer/): Science-backed 25/5 study intervals, ambient brown/white noise, full-screen mode, and session counters.
- [Precision Stopwatch & Laps](https://indiantimers.com/tools/stopwatch/): Lap split tracker for problem-solving speed drills and question pacing.
- [Study Session Timer](https://indiantimers.com/tools/study-timer/): Dedicated revision session tracker with daily study milestones and progress rings.
- [Custom Countdown Creator](https://indiantimers.com/tools/countdown/): Personalized countdowns with full-screen presentation, local offline persistence, and shareable URLs.
- [2027 Master Exam Calendar](https://indiantimers.com/calendar/2027/): Interactive monthly calendar mapping all 2026-2027 Indian exam dates and registration deadlines.

## Data Provenance & Verification Policy
- Every date is cross-audited against gazettes and official circulars from NTA (exams.nta.ac.in), UPSC (upsc.gov.in), IITs, and CBSE (cbse.gov.in).
- [Editorial & Verification Policy](https://indiantimers.com/editorial-policy/): Rigorous standards for validating official gazettes and schedule changes.
- Statuses are strictly classified into:
  - `Official Confirmed`: gazetted by authority.
  - `Tentative (Official Calendar)`: published in preliminary annual calendar.
  - `Expected`: based on audited 5-year historical trends, clearly flagged.
- For complete raw context and exam-by-exam schedules for LLM ingestion, see [llms-full.txt](https://indiantimers.com/llms-full.txt).
